question: Should Crabbox own and support a Cloud Run-hosted bridge for Google’s public-preview sandbox runtime?
rationale: The integration fits the provider architecture in principle, but it likely adds an owned hosted protocol, deployment and IAM setup, preview-API compatibility burden, and a funded-provider lifecycle obligation that require explicit product sponsorship.

options.title: Approve a bounded spike
options.body: Keep the issue open for a design, deployment, security, and live lifecycle feasibility spike before authorizing a production adapter.

options.title: Wait for API stability
options.body: Defer built-in support until Google exposes a stable remote-management surface or stronger user demand justifies the hosted bridge.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded spike
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a design, deployment, security, and live lifecycle feasibility spike before authorizing a production adapter.

likelyOwner.reason: The original GCP provider, current provider registry architecture, hosted bridge hardening, and exact-claim lifecycle work make this the strongest available owner for the product boundary decision.
